versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-kuaishou-visible-content-fetcher:

- Enables one-click structured data fetching from Kuaishou without account login.
- Supports video search by keyword, creator content fetching, and comment extraction via public data.
- Outputs results as structured JSON, suitable for topic research, competitor analysis, and trend monitoring.
- Handles up to 10,000 items per request; includes robust error handling and clear routing based on user input type.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; includes comprehensive usage and input guidelines.
